thread:
Sam Rivera: Quick sync from the authz postmortem: we surfaced 3 recurring patterns (token expiry mismatch, partial audit gaps when fallback flows run, and rotation alerts not firing). Need owners + short timelines. Suggest weekly check-ins until all items are closed.

Nina Gupta: I can pick up the expiry mismatch. Hypothesis: clock skew + ttl handling in the edge proxy. First step: add end-to-end test that simulates TTL drift and ensure validation logic uses server-signed timestamp. ETA: 2026-04-02.

Omar El-Amin: Ill take audit gaps. I want to run a coverage report to find which codepaths lack event emission (especially fallbacks). Ill also add a validation step in the log pipeline to assert presence of request_id, user_id, and auth_outcome. ETA: 2026-04-09.

Dina Lopez: Ill own rotation alert reliability. Plan: run a sweep of rotation jobs, add synthetic failure testing to exercise PagerDuty routing, and tighten alert thresholds. ETA: 2026-04-03.

Sam Rivera: Great. Please paste a compact action item summary (owner, task, ETA, blocker) so I can add to the remediation tracker. Also set the recurrence for triage (weekly) and monthly runbook review.

Nina Gupta: Action: Owner=Nina Gupta; Task=Token expiry mismatch investigation + tests; ETA=2026-04-02; Blocker=access to edge-proxy test harness (requesting from infra).

Omar El-Amin: Action: Owner=Omar El-Amin; Task=Audit coverage report + log schema enforcement; ETA=2026-04-09; Blocker=one consumer pipeline currently drops extra fields (tracking with ENG-988).

Dina Lopez: Action: Owner=Dina Lopez; Task=Rotation alert sweep + synthetic failures; ETA=2026-04-03; Blocker=need a PD escalation playbook for test alerts.

incident-bot: Created tasks T-9012, T-9013, T-9014 and linked them to incident-2026-03-authz. Weekly triage reminder scheduled: Wed 09:00 UTC.

Sam Rivera: Two ops asks: 1) Add a dashboard grouping token failures by "edge-proxy" vs "auth-service" and include time-to-expire as a label. 2) For audit coverage, include a heatmap of last-emit time per event type.

Nina Gupta: Will add the dashboard query. Starting point: `rate(token_expiry_failures[5m]) by (service, ttl_bucket)` then add panels for 95p latency.

Omar El-Amin: For heatmap I'll output last_emit_ts per event and feed to Grafana. If pipeline consumers remove fields, I will add a shim that re-injects minimal identity fields.

Dina Lopez: For synthetic failures, adding a k8s CronJob to flip a stub key and trigger rotation failure is simplest. Will open PR with job + PD test routing. Example stub: `curl -X POST https://ops-hook/internal/trigger-rotation-failure` in a job container.

Sam Rivera: Cool. Can we agree SLAs for closure in the tracker: P1 (expiry mismatch)=2w, P2 (audit gaps)=4w, P1 (rotation alerts)=2w. If anyone needs extension, flag in weekly triage.

Nina Gupta: Agree P1 2w.

Omar El-Amin: Agree P2 4w but may need extra time if consumer changes take longer. Will update T-9013 with dependencies.

Dina Lopez: Agree P1 2w.

incident-bot: Reminder set: runbook-review monthly on 2026-04-07 10:00 UTC.

Sam Rivera: Thanks team. I'll update the incident page with owners, SLAs, and link the tracker tasks. Posting the weekly triage invite now. :white_check_mark:
